newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST-Rolls year profits hit by steam.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Rolls year profits hit by steam.

text.p: Rationalisation costs will hit headline results at Rolls-Royce Plc next Thursday but the engines maker is also expected to have a 50 percent increase in underlying profits and an encouraging tally of new airline orders to report.

Analysts predict profits will come in at 205-235 million pounds before exceptional charges, up from 143 million pounds in 1995, but Rolls has to book in the 248 million pounds of provisions and write-offs detailed in the half-year results for its plan to bale out of the steam power generation business.

As a result the dividend payout is expected to be raised a modest 0.3-0.4 pence to 5.3-5.4 pence for the year, up from 5.0 pence in 1995. Analysts are cautioning that any good news on the core aero-engines and industrial power businesses is already discounted in the share price.

The share price was down 4-1/2p at 231p on Friday, in a generally lower market, but with earnings of around 12.5 pence forecast for 1996 and 15.5 pence forecast for 1997, the share price is already seen to be at a premium rating.

"Despite the fact that we are looking for good growth in terms of earnings, we are discounting it pretty heavily in terms of where the share price stands now," said investment analyst Andy Chambers of SocGen.
"Looking ahead, our view for earnings of about 18 pence (a share) in the year 2001 suggests that they are on a fairly hefty multiple," he said.

In the last year, Rolls has announced a string of new orders for its new big Trent turbofan engine for Boeing 777 and Airbus A330 "big twin" aircraft in its perennial battle with U.S. rivals General Electric and United Technologies unit Pratt & Whitney.

But analysts fear the manufacturers are selling engines for little or no immediate profit, with a view to earning a return on higher-margin spares later. So the main interest in next week's results will be on spares sales for old engines, rather than new aircraft orders.
